final:
class Bad:
    n: int

def check(x: int) -> int fail Bad:
    """Return x when it is even, otherwise fail with Bad(n=x)."""
    ex check(2) == 2
    ex check(3) == Err(Bad(n=3))
    if x % 2 == 1:
        fail Bad(n=x)
    return x

def all_even(xs: list[int]) -> list[int] fail Bad:
    """Check every element of xs in parallel. Return xs unchanged when all are even, otherwise fail with the failure of the lowest-index odd element, whichever check finishes first."""
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    ex all_even([2, 4, 6]) == [2, 4, 6]
    ex all_even([]) == []
    ex all_even([2, 3, 5]) == Err(Bad(n=3))
    ex all_even([7, 4, 9]) == Err(Bad(n=7))
    return par [check(x)? for x in xs]
